Callout.Name: Fire Ring - Restricted Area
Callout.Message: Fire lit in a restricted area overnight.
Callout.Advisory: Ring still warm, no persons present.

Script.Line: The ring was warm when I put my hand near it.
There is a lighter on the stones and a can.
Whoever it was is on the trail somewhere. They cannot be far.

Lines.Approach: Still warm when I got there, so somebody was sat here an hour ago.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
